events.title: SILENT FILM - THE PHANTOM FLYER - AL WILSON - 1928
events.description: Experience a classic 1928 silent film, 'The Phantom Flyer' starring Al Wilson, at the historic Majestic Theatre. This unique screening offers a glimpse into early cinema, often accompanied by live musical improvisation.

events.title: Making Mulch and Compost
events.description: Learn practical skills for sustainable gardening by attending this workshop on making mulch and compost. These sessions provide hands-on knowledge for cultivating healthy gardens and reducing waste.

events.title: Intro to Acrylics
events.description: Participate in an introductory workshop to acrylic painting, suitable for beginners looking to explore a new creative medium. These sessions offer practical guidance and a chance to develop artistic skills.

events.title: Fabric Painting
events.description: Engage in a hands-on fabric painting workshop, perfect for creative expression and learning new textile art techniques. These community-focused sessions are likely suitable for various skill levels.

events.title: Andrew Quilty: Afghanistan (Photographic Exhibition)
events.description: This powerful photographic exhibition by acclaimed photojournalist Andrew Quilty offers a raw and insightful look into life in Afghanistan. It explores human stories and resilience amidst complex geopolitical realities.

events.title: Lisa Wilkinson & Peter FitzSimons in Conversation
events.description: Join prominent media personalities Lisa Wilkinson and Peter FitzSimons for an engaging live conversation. They will discuss current affairs, their careers, and shared experiences, likely offering insights into media, politics, and culture.

events.title: Ross Noble - Cranium of Curiosities
events.description: Experience the unique free-associative comedy style of Ross Noble in his new show. Known for his improvisational genius and surreal observations, this promises an evening of original and thought-provoking humour.

events.title: HILLBILLY GOATS
events.description: Catch The Hillbilly Goats live at the Majestic Theatre, renowned for their authentic, high-energy hillbilly and roots music. Expect foot-stomping tunes and a vibrant atmosphere, celebrating traditional folk sounds.

events.title: Local Contemporary Art Prize 2026
events.description: This exhibition showcases contemporary artworks by local Sunshine Coast artists, offering a glimpse into the region's current creative landscape. It's an opportunity to experience diverse artistic expressions from community talent.

events.title: Glimpse by Cecile Bell
events.datetime: Until Sat 16 May 2026, during library opening hours
events.description: Explore 'Glimpse', an art exhibition by Cecile Bell, displayed within the Maroochydore Library Artspace. It offers a free opportunity to view local artistic talent in a community setting.

events.title: Going Coastal
events.description: This workshop delves into the history of local fishing spots on the Sunshine Coast, sharing insights and stories about the region's aquatic heritage. It's a chance to learn about local culture and environment.

events.title: Local Student Art Prize 2026
events.location: The Artroom, Caloundra Regional Gallery, Caloundra
events.description: Presented in The Artroom, this exhibition showcases the creative talents of local students, featuring works from emerging young artists. It celebrates youthful perspectives and new artistic voices from the community.

events.title: Everly Brothers & Friends and Roy Orbison
events.description: A tribute show celebrating the iconic music of The Everly Brothers, Roy Orbison, and their contemporaries. Expect a night of classic rock and roll hits and nostalgic melodies.
